title: A particle reinforced NbTaTiV refractory high entropy alloy based composite with attractive mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by mixing high purity Nb, Ta, Ti, and V powders with particle size less than 45 μm, ball milling for 12 h at 250 rpm in an argon atmosphere, and consolidating via spark plasma sintering at 1500°C, 1600°C, and 1700°C for 30 min under 30 MPa pressure.
